question: List every company that raised funding in Indian quick commerce since January 2026, with amounts, investors and dates.
answer: Based only on the supplied evidence, Dazzl raised $3.2 million from Stellaris and angels Ritesh Agarwal and Abhishek Bansal on January 13, 2026. Zilo raised $15.3 million from Peak XV Partners, Info Edge Ventures, Chiratae Ventures, Alteria Capital, Stride Ventures and named angels on February 5; HomeRun raised ₹60 crore (about $6.6 million) from Sorin Investments, Titan Capital, Sparrow, Consumer Collective and Helios on February 17. Inamo raised $8 million from Prime Venture Partners, Shastra VC, Antler India and Gemba Capital on March 2; Blinkit received ₹450 crore from parent Eternal on March 12; Swish raised $38 million from Hara Global, Bain Capital Ventures and Accel on March 23; Ozi raised $6.2 million from RTP Global, Blume, Huddle and Zerpact on March 25; and Pronto raised an initial $25 million, later extended to $45 million, from Epiq Capital, Lachy Groom and prior backers in March, although the exact day was not provided. BazaarNow raised ₹72 crore (about $7.5 million) from Peak XV Partners, Whiteboard Capital, Antler, Nirman Ventures and named angels around June 9–11; I preferred this finalized figure over the preliminary $9 million “in talks” headline because it is more specific to the completed event. Plazza raised $15 million from Accel, Elevation, Nexus, All In and Better Capital on July 20; Fixxly raised $5.5 million from Accel, Fireside and Lightspeed India on July 29; HomeRun raised another $12 million from Nexus Venture Partners, Sorin Investments, Titan Capital, Sparrow Capital and Consumer Collective on August 6; and Peeko raised ₹67.4 crore, reported as over $7 million, from Chiratae, Stellaris and angels on August 20. Zepto’s reported July 17 $800 million IPO was excluded because it was not confirmed as completed, while the evidence’s reference to a $55 million FirstClub raise from Peak XV, Sofina and others lacks an announcement date and therefore cannot be verified against the requested period.

retrieval.text:
India quick-commerce / instant-delivery funding rounds **announced after December 31, 2025**:

| Date | Startup | Vertical / delivery proposition | Round | Amount | Key investors |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| Jan. 13, 2026 | **Dazzl** | On-demand beauty and wellness services | Seed | **$3.2M** | Stellaris; angels including Ritesh Agarwal and Abhishek Bansal |
| Feb. 5, 2026 | **ZILO** | Fashion quick commerce; 60-minute delivery, home trials/returns | Series A | **$15.3M** | Peak XV; Info Edge Ventures; Chiratae |
| Feb. 17, 2026 | **HomeRun** | Construction and renovation-material delivery | Series A | **₹60 crore** (~$6.6M) | Sorin Investments; Titan Capital; Sparrow; Consumer Collective; Helios |
| Mar. 2, 2026 | **Inamo** | Quick-commerce enablement / operations and technology | Series A | **$8M** ($6M equity + $2M debt) | Prime Venture Partners |
| Mar. 23, 2026 | **Swish** | Fresh-food delivery in 10–15 minutes | Series B | **$38M** | Hara Global; Bain Capital Ventures; Accel |
| Mar. 25, 2026 | **Ozi** | Baby and kids’ products; ~60-minute delivery | Series A | **$6.2M** | RTP Global; Blume; Huddle; Zerpact |
| Mar. 2026 | **Pronto** | Instant household-help / home services, often ~10-minute dispatch | Series B | **$25M** initial close; later extended to **$45M** | Epiq Capital; later Lachy Groom; prior backers participated |
| Jun. 9–11, 2026 | **BazaarNow** | Grocery and daily-essentials quick commerce | Funding round *(stage not publicly specified)* | **₹72 crore** (~$7.5M) | Peak XV; Whiteboard; Antler |
| Jul. 20, 2026 | **Plazza** | Quick medicine delivery | Series A | **$15M** | Accel; Elevation; Nexus; All In; Better Capital |
| Jul. 29, 2026 | **Fixxly** | Building-materials quick commerce | Seed | **$5.5M** | Accel; Fireside; Lightspeed India |
| Aug. 6, 2026 | **HomeRun** | Construction and interior-material delivery | Series A+ | **$12M** | Nexus; existing investors including Sorin, Titan, Sparrow |
| Aug. 20, 2026 | **Peeko** | Baby-care quick commerce | Series A | **₹67.4 crore** (over $7M) | Chiratae; Stellaris; angels |

The clearest theme is capital moving beyond groceries into **vertical quick commerce**: construction materials (HomeRun, Fixxly), baby care (Ozi, Peeko), medicine (Plazza), fashion (ZILO), food (Swish), and rapid services (Dazzl, Pronto). ([moneycontrol.com](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/funding/dazzl-raises-3-2-million-in-seed-funding-from-stellaris-to-build-quick-commerce-platform-for-beauty-services-13770613.html?utm_source=openai))

**Note:** I excluded deals merely reported as fundraising discussions unless there was a subsequent reported close, and I marked BazaarNow separately because coverage described the amount and investors but did not clearly label the stage.
